screened_architecture.each_call: Fresh uniform index-two subgroup domain, compute f, known codomain-controlled isometry on arbitrary incoming quantum memory, uncompute f, binary uniform-domain projection, discard domain in every branch.
retained: full-dimensional encoder outputs and all ancillas
incoming quantum memory and entangled reference
screened_architecture.subgroup_selection: Classically adaptive, no finite encoder-menu or Hilbert-dimension restriction.
screened_architecture.simulation: m fresh classical label samples per call, multiplicity-preserving quantum sample-table preparation; one fixed underlying oracle for the entire protocol.
screened_architecture.overhead: Tm classical function evaluations, explicit O(m*(label_bits+log m)) known multiplexed lookup per call, original controlled-encoder circuit and uniform-index/precision costs.
screened_architecture.not_a_claim: The known downstream quantum computation is not simulated by a classical computer.

mathematical_interfaces.variance_channel: V(rho)=E(rho)-M rho M^dagger is CP and trace-nonincreasing, also with an entangled reference.
mathematical_interfaces.empirical_channel_error: Expected empirical-minus-true channel has tagged blocks +/-V(rho)/m; reference-assisted trace error <=1/m regardless of memory dimension.
mathematical_interfaces.joint_simulation: Conditional on the fixed oracle, adaptive T-call error <=T/m per hidden hypothesis; no nuisance resampling.
mathematical_interfaces.label_information_gate: For fixed uniform random output permutation and label-only correct-half/wrong-full samplers, Q adaptive label samples have distance<=Q(Q-1)/(2N).
mathematical_interfaces.scoped_source_screen: Original parity distance<=2T/m+(Tm)(Tm-1)/(2N), capped1; initial memory must be secret-independent and no other oracle resources supplied.
mathematical_interfaces.postselection_boundary: Complete-output simulation does not preserve rare conditional pure-image outputs; full-label accepted overlap m/(m+M-1) can be tiny.

proof_obligations.PO-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW: Review CP variance, reference-assisted channel error, both-hypothesis hybrid and adaptive fixed-subset coupling. Tests do not certify proofs.
proof_obligations.PO-ACCESS: Specify exactly which domain registers survive, which operations depend on domain indices, and which subgroup/oracle controls are coherent. Demonstrate why an outside-screen primitive changes the source channel.
proof_obligations.PO-NATURAL-REDUCTION: Connect an outside-screen input or meaningful label semantics to a consequential problem with charged parameter, input-generation and error losses.
proof_obligations.PO-CLASSICAL-COMPUTATION: Classical-query quantum-processing simulation is not a classical runtime attack. Compare actual classical decoding and known quantum processing under the same natural data promise.
proof_obligations.PO-COST: Charge empirical query counts, classical table storage, reversible loading, controlled encoder implementation and precision. An analytically exponential sample list is not free algorithm advice.
proof_obligations.PO-CONTROLLED-PHASE: Known controlled W_y implementations must preserve specified relative phases and cannot hide extra unknown-oracle calls. Standalone black-box CPTP maps do not define those controlled phases.
proof_obligations.PO-POSTSELECTION: Certify conditional error relative to the true herald mass, rather than transferring an unconditional trace bound through rare acceptance.
proof_obligations.PO-CFIP: Obtain exact CFIP full text and access assumptions before naming it as a costed algorithmic primitive.

experiments_with_falsifiers.experiment: Exact empirical-channel variance and full-input norm checks.
experiments_with_falsifiers.falsifier: A permitted input/reference exceeds1/m error, a noncommuting operator breaks CP variance, or sample values are deduplicated.

experiments_with_falsifiers.experiment: Adaptive entangled-memory experiment with shared hidden subset.
experiments_with_falsifiers.falsifier: Full flag/memory output exceedsT/m per-hypothesis error or the simulator resamples the underlying oracle.

experiments_with_falsifiers.experiment: Cost a domain-dependent or coherent-domain primitive outside the screened template.
experiments_with_falsifiers.falsifier: It reduces to the same label-only channel, grants an inverse/image oracle, or has no natural reduction and matched baseline.
Its advantage is known classical reconstruction, free advice, uncharged conditional erasure or a changed unmotivated source promise.
